text: Hosted-readiness audit found the scale workflow's default dependency mode included all Suggests, including exact-version fmridesign/fmrireg packages that are not in mainstream repositories. The scale court itself does not require those adapters. The workflow will install only Depends/Imports/LinkingTo plus its explicit test and process tools, run the canonical map scripts into an auditable result directory, run the 50k topology court directly, and upload source-revision-bound receipts.
